title: Rig Relay Fleet Coordination Event v1
description: Canonical fleet coordination event envelope — append-only JSONL authority ledger.

event_id.description: SHA256-based deterministic event identity, e.g. sha256(canonical_payload)[:24]

claim_id.description: UUID4 claim lifecycle identity — stable across acquisition, renewal, transitions, release, and parking

agent_id.description: Agent or session identifier performing the operation

workspace_authority_id.description: Stable workspace authority identifier (maps to ExecutionWorkspace.workspace_id UUID or derived repository identity digest)

base_sha256_by_path.description: SHA256 file-content digests at claim acquisition time, keyed by relative path

lane_output_sha256_by_path.description: SHA256 file-content digests after lane edits/tests, recorded at ready_for_integration

event_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number derived from ledger file at append time

prior_event_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the immediate prior event in the ledger (null for first event)

event_digest.description: SHA256 digest of this event's canonical JSON (excluding the event_digest field itself)

reason_code.description: Typed reason for refusal or terminal transition

details.description: Content-light metadata only — no sources, prompts, secrets, diffs, file bodies, or terminal stdout
